7-12

Dear Sir,

My friends and I have smoked 1st Choice Lights 100's in the flip top box for a number of years. The problem is that when we buy them out on slot, let 1st Choice Cigarettes, most are not the 1st Choice Lights 100's flip top. I know at least ten of my friends who smoke the 1st Choice 100's light flip top. You are losing money if they can't fill them. Why? They and I will buy the Marlboro Light 100's flip top before we buy only the first choice. I enjoy the 1st Choice 100's lights flip top and thought you might like to know about losing money on your cigarette because we can't get what we want to pay for.

Had to smoke the Marlboro flip top today. Even they didn't have the 1st Choice 100's lights flip top box. I always buy (x2) Cartons since I let my friends smoke with me. Would you please put some 1st Choice 100's light flip top box on the shelves?

Thank you

Lois Barnes
209 Townsend Rd W.
Hodges, S.C. 29653

P.S.
Please don't raise the price because we like them. Could lower it a little if you would like to sell more.
